lessons.title: Tâi-lô consonants: p and ph, ts and tsh, and the voiced b, g, j
Vowels and endings: o and oo, nasal nn, and the stops -p -t -k -h
The seven tones and their marks
Tone sandhi 1: every syllable but the last changes
Tone sandhi 2: checked syllables, 仔, and the neutral tone after --
Greetings: 𠢕早, 食飽未？, 多謝, 歹勢, 再會
Reading Taigi characters: 毋, 佇, 遮, 欲, 予
Classroom phrases: 請閣講一擺, 慢慢仔講
是 and 毋是; 我, 你, 伊, and two words for we: 阮 and 咱
Introducing yourself: 你號做啥物名？ 我是學生
Question words: 啥物, 啥人, 佗位, 當時, 按怎
Two sets of numbers: counting, and reading digits
Family: 阿爸, 阿母, 阿公, 阿媽, 阿兄
有 and 無: have, there is, and questions with 無 and 敢
Classifiers: 一个人, 兩本冊, 三碗飯; 這 and 彼
Money and prices: 偌濟錢？, 箍, 傷貴
Want and need: 欲, 愛, 想欲
Where things are: 佇, 遮 and 遐, 頂懸, 下跤
Directions: 正手, 倒手, 直直行, 斡
Going and coming: 去, 來, 坐車, 捷運
Time and days: 幾點？, 今仔日, 禮拜日
At the night market: 頭家, 一碗麵, 好食
At the market: 菜, 肉, 卵, 魚, and asking how much
Describing and comparing: 真, 誠, 足; 比…較, 上
Can and may: 會 and 袂, 會使, 會曉
Four words for not: 毋, 無, 袂, 莫
Actions in time: 咧 (in progress), 矣 (done), 有…過 (ever)

decks.name: Tâi-lô sounds
decks.desc: One word for each Tâi-lô letter or ending that misleads English readers: ph, th, kh, tsh, b, g, j, oo, nn, and the stops -p -t -k -h.

decks.name: Seven tones
decks.desc: The tone mnemonic 獅虎豹鱉猴狗象鹿 (sai hóo pà pih kâu káu tshiūnn lo̍k): one animal per tone, with its mark.

decks.name: Tone sandhi in action
decks.desc: Two-syllable words whose first syllable is said in its sandhi tone, while the last keeps the tone you see.

decks.name: Taigi characters
decks.desc: Characters that Taiwanese writes and Mandarin does not use this way: 毋, 佇, 欲, 予, 媠, 囝, 厝, 睏, 啉.

decks.name: Greetings and courtesy
decks.desc: Good morning, have you eaten?, thank you, sorry and goodbye.

decks.name: People and family
decks.desc: Pronouns (我, 你, 伊, 阮, 咱, 恁, 𪜶) and the family words a grandchild needs.

decks.name: About me
decks.desc: Name, surname, being a student, where you live.

decks.name: In class
decks.desc: Asking the teacher to repeat, to slow down, and saying you don't know.

decks.name: Numbers and money
decks.desc: Counting numbers, the literary numbers for digits, and prices in 箍.

decks.name: Classifiers
decks.desc: Number or this / that + classifier + noun: 个, 本, 隻, 碗, 杯, 擺.

decks.name: Night market food
decks.desc: The night market, its stalls and its food.

decks.name: At the market
decks.desc: The traditional market: vegetables, meat, eggs, fish and fruit, and haggling over price.

decks.name: Time and days
decks.desc: Today, tomorrow, yesterday, parts of the day, the week and the clock.

decks.name: Places and directions
decks.desc: In front, behind, above, below, left, right, and turning.

decks.name: Getting around
decks.desc: MRT, trains, taxis, walking, getting on.

decks.name: Questions and particles
decks.desc: Question words and the yes/no questions with 無, 未, 敢 and 是毋是.

decks.name: Describing and comparing
decks.desc: Very, too, more, most; and actions in progress or done.

decks.name: Traps for English speakers
decks.desc: No "to be" with adjectives, the four negatives, 會 and 袂, sound-alikes and false friends.
